contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Reach out to me by my email for collaboration, consultation or general inquiries.

seishinkaiKarate.title: Seishinkai Karate
seishinkaiKarate.desc: Their 30-year-old website was holding them back on SEO and customer join-up rate. As a solo project, I handled the full lifecycle myself — proposal, client communication, design, development, deployment, and maintenance — to redesign and rebuild the site from the ground up. The result was a major lift in SEO, join-up rate, and overall UX, and the owner was satisfied enough to keep me on for all future updates.

gamerblog.title: Gamer Blog Site
gamerblog.desc: The client, a Twitch streamer and YouTuber, felt his old site no longer reflected who he was as a creator. I designed and built a replacement blog site around his gamer identity, which improved both UX and SEO in the process.

artistPortfolio.title: Artist Portfolio
artistPortfolio.desc: The client, a visual artist, needed a way for new contacts to grasp the range of her work at a glance from nothing more than a business card. I built a landing page reachable via QR code, curating hand-picked pieces from her most recent exhibitions. This low-tech solution has made it easier for her to engage with future clients.

gamingSite.title: Gaming Site
gamingSite.desc: I wanted a public showcase for the browser games I build in my free time. I designed and developed the platform myself as a personal project, and now maintain a growing library of in-browser playable games — currently over a dozen.

OzTools.title: Dev Tools Site
OzTools.desc: My coworkers needed quick access to a handful of small dev and design utilities scattered across different tools. I built a single utility site to consolidate them, and keep adding new custom-built tools as needs come up — currently 11 and counting.

gyoren.title: Fisheries Federation Digital Encyclopedia
gyoren.desc: This client, a fisheries federation in Hokkaido, wanted an engaging way to share bite-sized stories about local seafood with the public. As head developer, I made the key functionality and tech stack decisions behind an interactive digital fish encyclopedia, giving visitors an approachable way to explore the region's catch.

mebs.title: Private Client Kids Tablet App
mebs.desc: This client needed a way to teach kids how elevators and escalators work through a tablet-first educational experience. I co-directed and developed the project, bridging the Japanese design/client side with a Malaysian development team to bring it to life.
mebs.alt: Private client kids elevator and escalator exploration app preview

marugame.title: Private Client Summer Campaign
marugame.desc: This client, an udon restaurant chain, needed a landing page to support their summer campaign. I built the page as developer, working with Gulp against their existing CMS to get it live.
marugame.alt: Private client summer campaign landing page preview
